Delay of Commencement Date.  Landlord shall not be liable for any damage or loss incurred by Tenant for Landlord’s failure or inability, for whatever cause or reason, to deliver possession of the Premises by any particular date (including the Lease Commencement Date), nor shall this Lease be void or voidable on account of such failure or inability to deliver possession of the Premises. Notwithstanding the foregoing, if Landlord does not deliver possession of the Premises to Tenant by the date which is sixty (60) days from the Lease Commencement Date, Tenant shall have the right to terminate this Lease by written notice to Landlord, indicating Tenant’s desire to terminate this Lease (the “Delay Notice”).  Landlord shall have thirty (30) days after Landlord’s receipt of the Delay Notice, to tender possession of the Premises to Tenant, and in the event that Landlord is still unable to deliver possession of the Premises to Tenant within such time, then upon the thirty-first (31st) day after Landlord’s receipt of the Delay Notice (the “Delay Termination Date”), this Lease shall be deemed terminated, and of no further force or effect, with Landlord and Tenant thereafter being relieved of any further obligations to one another under this Lease.  Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Delay Termination Date shall be extended by the number of days that work on the Premises is delayed due to no fault of Landlord, or the   fault, neglect, acts or omissions of Tenant, or due to acts of God, labor disputes, strikes, fires, rainy or stormy weather, acts or failures to act of public agencies, inability to obtain labor or materials, earthquake, war, insurrection, riots and other causes beyond Landlord’s reasonable control.  In the event of any delay in delivery of the Premises to Tenant, the Lease Term shall remain unaffected, and this Lease shall terminate on the Lease Termination Date.

Delay of Commencement Date.  Except as expressly set forth in this Section 4.2, Landlord shall not be liable for any damage or loss incurred by Tenant for Landlord’s failure or inability, for whatever cause or reason, to deliver possession of the Premises by any particular date (including the Lease Commencement Date), nor shall this Lease be void or voidable on account of such failure or inability to deliver possession of the Premises. Notwithstanding the foregoing, if Landlord does not deliver possession of the Premises to Tenant in the Delivery Condition on or before November 1, 2026 (the “Outside Delivery Date”), Tenant shall have the right to terminate this Lease by written notice to Landlord, indicating Tenant’s desire to terminate this Lease (the “Delay Notice”).  This Lease shall terminate on the tenth (10th) day after Landlord’s receipt of the Delay Notice (the “Delay Termination Date”), and Landlord shall, within ten (10) days thereafter, refund to Tenant the Security Deposit and all prepaid Base Rent, Direct Costs, and other amounts paid by Tenant, and reimburse Tenant for its documented out-of-pocket architectural, engineering, permitting, and outside legal costs incurred in reliance on this Lease.  Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Delay Termination Date shall be extended by the number of days, not to exceed thirty (30) days in the aggregate, that work on the Premises is delayed by the   fault, neglect, acts or omissions of Tenant, or due to acts of God, labor disputes, strikes, fires, rainy or stormy weather, acts or failures to act of public agencies, inability to obtain labor or materials, earthquake, war, insurrection, riots and other causes beyond Landlord’s reasonable control.  In the event of any delay in delivery of the Premises to Tenant, the Lease Term shall not commence until the date Landlord delivers possession of the Premises in the Delivery Condition, and the Lease Termination Date shall be extended day-for-day accordingly.

Confidential Information. In performing under this Agreement, each Party (as “Receiving Party”) may obtain Confidential Information of the other (“Disclosing Party”), whether such information is conveyed in writing, orally, visually, or via electronic or magnetic media. Except where expressly authorized herein, no Party shall disclose any Confidential Information of the other Party to any third party, whether during the Term or thereafter. A Receiving Party shall have no further non-disclosure obligation under this Agreement with respect to Confidential Information to the extent that such information: (a) was, at the time of disclosure, or has since become, publicly available without any wrongful act of the Receiving Party; (b) was already lawfully in the Receiving Party’s possession at the time of disclosure, free of any confidentiality obligation and not as a result of any breach of legal duty; (c) was lawfully obtained by the Receiving Party from a third party that owed no direct or indirect confidentiality obligation to the Disclosing Party and had the right to disclose such information; or (d) is required to be disclosed by the Receiving Party to a court or governmental or regulatory authority pursuant to a governmental order, subpoena, court order, or Applicable Law, provided that (i) the Receiving Party first gives the Disclosing Party prior written notice, if allowed by the governmental order, subpoena, court order, or Applicable law and undertakes reasonable, lawful steps to avoid or limit the scope of such disclosure, and (ii) the disclosure does not include information that could identify any particular individual or device, unless a governmental order, subpoena, court order, or Applicable law requires the disclosure of such identifying information.
